about: Frozen list of known rights discrepancies (ingestion plan v1.2 §6, slice 5). Every curriculum manifest source release must declare its operation in metadata.use; an undeclared release fails CI unless it is listed here, tied to an open decision. An entry that no longer matches a real discrepancy also fails, so this list can only shrink. A manifest with an entry here cannot be published (tool/ci/verify_content_sources.py --publish-check).
